{{Top|leg}}
'''Hinder Market''', sometimes referred to as simply "the Hinder," was located on [[Hinder Island]] on [[Recopia]]. The Hinder was a huge market where [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] who dealt in shipping live animals to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] met to bargain with one another.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
